title: Tillage and the time and form of the fertiliser
intro: The tillage action (plowing, rotavation, or none) mixes the residues and the topsoil; the fertiliser is taken from the fertilizer library by name, and the date can be moved. These three decide how much nitrate is exposed to leaching.
